text:
kari: Quick sync recap from today's vendor call — aligning marketplace rollout and SI handoffs for H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. Key asks: exact driver/firmware freeze dates, regional power limits, and embargo windows.

ben: jotting notes. action focus: 1) confirm driver tags 2) SI validation matrix 3) marketplace SKU fields 4) fallback policy for perf regressions

hiro: perf highlight — H200 sustained 4k seq tests on EU racks hit 15% derate when inlet temp >28C. please request vendor thermal patch or reduced power cap in EU images. :thermometer_face: 

sophie: labs availability: can host multi-node MI300 runs Wed/Thu next week if canaries arrive Mon noon. need signed images + release notes.

vendor-bot: Published tags: h100-fw-2024-06-01, h200-canary:v20240603, b200-image:v20240602, mi300-fw-2024-05-30, gaudi-driver:v2.0.

marcos: SI asks: we need sample IaC for VPC peering + a test dataset (10 short+5 long prompts) and a smoke checklist. can redwood share these?

kari: yes — will attach IaC snippets after thread. smoke checklist (short): boot, driver load, nvlink, single-node latency, multi-node long-seq throughput, thermal trace capture.

ben: marketplace SKU fields proposal: sku_id, vendor_tag, max_seq, recommended_quant, power_profile, fallback_model_tag, region_limits, notes_url. OK?

hiro: add thermal_counters_required boolean and sampling_ms. we need high-frequency counters for correlation.

sophie: marketing note  need 10-day embargo buffer after driver freeze to prepare docs and partner quotes. vendors please confirm freeze date.

vendor-bot: Vendors requested driver-freeze targets: H100/B200 -> 2024-06-10; H200 -> 2024-06-17 (may slip); MI300/Gaudi -> 2024-06-20.

marcos: SI risk: if H200 slips >4 days, we'll scope dry-run to core flows only. flagging to partners.

kari: proposed short timeline (draft):
- H100/B200: canary Jun 3-5 -> driver freeze Jun 10 -> marketplace preview Jun 20 -> public Jun 27
- H200: canary Jun 6-9 -> perf validation Jun 10-16 -> driver freeze Jun 17 -> preview Jun 27 -> public Jul 4
- MI300/Gaudi: canary Jun 10-14 -> extended perf Jun 15-21 -> driver freeze Jun 20 -> preview Jul 1 -> public Jul 8

hiro: request fallback rule in marketplace entry: if perf regression >8% on H200 long-seq, automatically route to fallback_model_tag (e.g., b200-stable) for preview customers.

kari: agreed. I'll draft fallback language.

ben: action items: 1) vendors post "ACK + firmware tag" in-thread (vendors) 2) redwood share IaC snippets and smoke checklist (kari) 3) perf run on canaries (hiro) 4) marketing confirm embargo buffer (sophie) 5) SI risk matrix (marcos)

vendor-bot: Meeting link: https://meet.redwood.ai/partners/1732109999. Reminder sent to vendor leads.

kari: thanks — please reply ASAP so we can lock freeze dates before Friday. :white_check_mark:
